safety_confirm: Say "ready" or tap "It's safe" when you've done that.
yes_next: Yes, that's right! Next up, step {n}: {text}
yes_last: Yes, that's right! That was the last step. Great work.
cant_see_yet: I can't see your work yet. Move your hands out of the way and ask me again.
couldnt_check: I couldn't check just now. Hold still and ask me again.
looks_good: Looks good. Let me make sure.
first_step: We're already on the first step.
listening_replay: I'm listening. Ask me anything about this lesson.
welcome_back: Welcome back. Picking up at step {n}.
confirm_done: This one matters, so you have the final say. Check: {text} Is that right? Say yes or no.
override_ok: Okay, you know your setup. Moving on.
override_check: Okay, let me look again properly.
too_dark: It's a bit dark for me. Can you turn on a light, or move closer to one?
too_blurry: The picture's blurry. Hold the camera steady, or tap the screen to focus.
